insight: Renamed from Leya; the Stockholm startup hit a $5.55B valuation in a March 2026 Series D led by Accel.
name: Legora
tagline: Collaborative legal AI for research, review, and drafting.
description: Legora is a legal AI workspace for law firms and in-house teams that handles multi-document review, legal research, and drafting across complex matters. Formerly known as Leya, it is built largely on Anthropic's Claude. Sold to enterprise legal teams on per-seat annual contracts.
edge: Collaborative legal workspace (formerly Leya) built largely on Claude — positioned as Harvey's main challenger.
